title: Call: Hollow Court Care Center Needs Vans and an Answer by 10:00

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - EOC Command Desk, Courthouse Annex

transcript.speaker: Administrator
transcript.text: Good morning, this is Rosa Delgado, administrator at Hollow Court Care Center down in Cedar Hollow. I need the Coordinator, and I need a few straight answers this morning.

transcript.speaker: Administrator
transcript.text: I have 36 residents. Eleven use wheelchairs, four are on oxygen, and two are on bariatric beds. Our evacuation plan takes twelve hours, eight vans and a paratransit bus. That's twelve hours from the moment the first resident moves, not from when somebody decides.

transcript.speaker: Administrator
transcript.text: Here's my problem. My contract van company called me at seven. They're booked Thursday on a hospital transfer job. All of their wheelchair vans. If I don't lock in vehicles today, I won't have them at all.

transcript.speaker: Administrator
transcript.text: So, first question. You've got 21.8 feet on the warning now, and I've been told our building floods at 19. Is this going to turn into an evacuation order? And when?

transcript.speaker: Administrator
transcript.text: Second. Can the county commit eight vans and the bus to Hollow Court right now? Not maybe, not later. Committed, with a time I can put on my staffing sheet.

transcript.speaker: Administrator
transcript.text: And third, who's taking my residents? Our plan says we stage at Ferris Crossing Community Hall and then go on to the receiving nursing home in Linden Falls. They've offered us the beds, but they want a yes by ten o'clock this morning or they give them to someone else.

transcript.speaker: Administrator
transcript.text: I've got 41 staff on days and families already calling me about the Facebook post. I'd rather move them early on a calm day than at night with water in the parking lot. I'll stay on the line, or call me back at 319-555-0167. But I need to tell the receiving home something before ten.

voiceStyles.Administrator: Woman in her 50s, calm and organized but clearly under pressure; speaks quickly, a phone ringing and a call bell in the background of a care facility office

instructorNote: Pressure inject on evacuation lead time: on the 18:00 Tuesday issuance the river reaches 19.0 ft around 08:00 Friday, so the order deadline is about 14:00 Thursday. This is a decision point: the Coordinator should decide what to promise the care center before any order exists, using the advisory already issued at I-04 and the current issuance, and record the basis for the choice. Field Operations should add Hollow Court and the 22 medical-needs households to the door-to-door plan.
